page.layout: One page of running text in a single column. Line numbers (5, 10, 15 and so on) stand in the left margin. Page number and running head sit at the top. Signature and catchword sit at the foot.

main_text.p: variæ in typis, sacrificiis, personis, rebus & actionibus ecclesiasticis in Leuitico. Relatio mutua est inter ea, quæ sunt sub uno genere: vt inter maritum & vxorem, Gen. 2. Relatio non mutua est inter ea, quæ sunt sub diuerso genere: 5re; vt inter Deum & nos, Psal. 100. v. 3. Christum & Ecclesiam.Eph. 5.

IX. Quæ sequuntur prædicamenta, sunt secundaria. Exiis Quando est notatio temporis: Vbi est notatio loci: Situs est circumstantia positionis corporum: 10Habitus est circumstantia vestitus. Exempla primi prædicamenti sunt Psalm. 106: secundi, Num. 34: tertii, Num. 33. Exod. 37. & 38. quarti, Exod. 28.
main_text.head: COLLATIO LOGICÆ CVM GRAMMATICA EX S. LI-TERIS.
main_text.p: 20I. COllatio Logicæ cum Grammaticâ ex sacris literis monstrat exempla, in quibus verba sunt indicia affectionis Logicæ: idq; in locis inuentionis, axiomate, syllogismo & methodo.

25II. In locis inuentionis affectiones rerum certis vocabulis exprimuntur. Et principio quidem genitiuus vim suam spargit per omnes fere locos inuentionis. Notat enim causam efficientem, vt Matth. 25. v. 3034. Marc. 1. v. 24. vel causam finalem, vt Iohan. 17. v. 12. Rom. 8. v. 36. 2. Thess. 2. v. 3. vel materiam, vt Act. 2. v. 3. vel formam, vt Leuit. 5. v. 21. vel effectum, vt Gen. 35. v. 18. Luc. 1. v. 69. vel subiectum, vt Gen. 18. v. 21: vel adiunctum, vt Gen. 24. v. 48. vel totum, vt Leuit. 16. v. 5. vel partitionem, vt Gen. 36. v. 15: 35vel speciem, vt Exod. 29. v. 2. &c. Atque hinc dicitur genitiuus causæ, effecti, subiecti, obiecti, maiorum, minorum,

page.notes: Printed marginal line numbers (5, 10, 15, 20, 25, 30, 35) are transcribed as notes at their lines. Stray marks near "variæ" and beside "IX." are not transcribed. The drop cap "C" of "Collatio" is joined to the word. "Ecclesiam.Eph.5." is read from a slightly broken line where the long s and the hyphenated word are hard to separate, so the reading is doubtful. "Exiis" is doubtful and is kept as printed.
